periods.label: 法米利昂国王的裁量

status.current: declares dissatisfaction with the Ethics Committee and reserves judgment on Ikki until after Seven Stars

relationships.stella-vermillion: Overprotective father who dotes on her intensely.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Potential son-in-law; says he will judge after Ikki visits Vermillion post-tournament.
relationships.vermillion-queen: Stella says her mother can restrain or imprison him when needed.

periods.summary: Stella describes her father as a doting, overprotective king who may try to bury Ikki in darkness if he learns of the relationship. During the scandal, Akaza uses a message about the king's reaction as leverage. After Ikki's victory, the king hears the facts and the duel result, expresses strong displeasure toward the Ethics Committee and the manipulated media, and states that Ikki should visit Vermillion after the Seven Stars Festival before he makes a final judgment.

key_events.summary: Stella and Ikki discuss eventually meeting her parents.
Akaza claims the king is interested in the duel, using him as leverage.
His post-scandal statement helps end public attacks on Ikki.
